purpose: Per-fix REQUIRED composition markers for the NEXT l26 PRX. verify_build.sh --manifest requires every declared marker to be composed into the PRX and exits nonzero on any miss. The 2026-10-09/10 phantom class (fix present in the tree, never composed into the PRX, caught only after a wasted console launch) is exactly what this manifest gate exists to catch before upload.

encoding_rules.utf-16le: PRIMARY. Wide STR()/StringType literals (UE4SS Prospero char16_t) land UTF-16LE in the binary. The phantom class was wide template literals composed out at link time.
encoding_rules.utf-8: Narrow char*/snprintf/fmt::format template literals and Lua chunk bytes land UTF-8.
encoding_rules.required[].encodings: Entry PASSES only when the text is present in EVERY listed encoding (both => both mandatory, e.g. send_narrow_diag wide-fallback + narrow-fmt pairs).
encoding_rules.required[].either_encoding: true => entry passes when present in at least ONE of the listed encodings; used for markers whose source has not landed yet (concurrent agents FD/FF author them now); both encodings are still checked and reported. Owner tightens encodings once the literal form lands.

marker_source_note: Every landed marker's text/encoding was read from the actual candidate sources (typescan-r4/candidate/src/*.cpp + typescan-r4/include/LuaFNameBridge.hpp); runtime-RENDERED lines (e.g. a logged '[ST] lua-ffo PASS' line) never appear contiguously in the PRX, so those markers are declared as their composable literals (template prefix + probe-name literal), all of which must be present.
